thread:
morgan: Quick notestaging shows routes with fncall schema_reject fallbacks have 0 kvcache metrics in the console. Intentional?

lina: Yep, runtime only emitted kvcache on successful fncall path. Fallbacks skipped emits.

samir: That avoided billing confusion. But ops/PM want visibility for rollouts.

olivia: Proposal: always emit kvcache.* with labels fallback=true and fallback_reason="schema_reject". Billing ETL will drop metrics with fallback=true. Start sampled (1%) on high-traffic routes.

morgan: Good. Console should not explode with cardinatlity. Suggest a UI toggle "include fallbacks" that adds fallback label to queries.

lina: I'll add a saved view + doc blurb explaining sampling.

samir: We'll compute fallback_rate in metrics pipeline and add alert: >5% for 10m and min 1k calls.

infra-bot: deploy queued: metrics/fallback-labels -> infra/staging (owner: olivia)

olivia: Action items: runtime label + flag (olivia), billing filter (samir), console toggle + saved view (lina), canary 1% -> 10% (morgan). I'll post flag name + sample metrics after deploy.

morgan: Thanks allaim for 48h canary then reevaluate. :thumbsup:
